name: Hangzhou Heatwell Electric Heating Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Heatwell Electric Heating Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2002 and headquartered in Hangzhou, China, is an enterprise dedicated to the research, development, production, and international sales of electric heating elements and associated components. The company's extensive product portfolio encompasses a wide array of heating solutions: Tubular heating elements are produced for numerous applications, including various small home appliances, washing machines, diverse water heater types (storage, instantaneous, solar), dishwashers, coffee machines, sanitary fixtures, steam generators, deep fryers, defrosting systems, finned air heaters, microwave and BBQ ovens, and cartridge heaters. Open coil heating elements are supplied for devices like warm air blowers, dryers, air conditioners, and quartz tubes. Cast aluminum heating elements are manufactured for both cast-in and die-cast applications. The company also offers assembly heaters, tubes, and radiant heaters. Beyond consumer-grade products, Hangzhou Heatwell provides specialized commercial heating elements for deep fryers and coffee machines, alongside highly customized heaters for specific industrial equipment across sectors such as automotive, medical and laboratory instrumentation, mold temperature control systems, boilers, heat pumps, and general air heating. Their offerings also include explosion-proof heaters and integrated heater assemblies complete with control cabinets. Furthermore, the company diversifies its production to include components utilized in disinfection and sterilization processes.
